## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Location

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| File | `path/to/file.md` |
| Section | Section name or line number |
| URL | Link if applicable |

## Expected Behavior

What should happen or what should the content say?

## Actual Behavior

What is actually happening or what does the content actually say?

## Bug Type

- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Incorrect information
- [ ] Mermaid diagram not rendering
- [ ] Formatting issue
- [ ] Missing content
- [ ] Outdated information
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Evidence

If applicable, add screenshots or paste the problematic content:

```markdown
<!-- Paste problematic markdown here -->
```

## Source Reference

If this is about inaccurate Codex-RS documentation:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Codex-RS File | `codex-rs/path/to/file.rs` |
| Line Number | Line or range |
| Commit/Version | If known |

## Environment

- [ ] Viewed on GitHub
- [ ] Viewed in VS Code
- [ ] Viewed in Cursor
- [ ] Viewed with glow
- [ ] Other: ___

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided the file path where the bug exists
- [ ] I have described what I expected vs what actually happened
